text:
Mira: heads-up — deploying release/2026.03.21 to prod 23:00 UTC. We'll open ff `llm-route-v2` to 10% at 23:05 then 50% at 23:20.
DeployBot: queued deploy (id: dq-6432109876) — starting traffic-shift steps.
Mira: plan: pin model v3.1 on canary nodes, keep fallback to v3.0. If telemetry flags, auto-fallback enabled.
Doug: re: pin — confirm rollback tag available?
Anya: rollback tag `release/2026.03.21-rollback` created and verified.
DeployBot: canary deploy succeeded — 2/2 services healthy, KV cache warmed.
Mira: opening flag to 10% now — please watch latency & top errors. @Sasha @Ops-Oncall
Sasha: seeing ~1.2x p95 increase on `llm-stream` path, adding note to timeline.
Ops-Oncall: enabling slow-start throttle (burst window -> 300ms) and reducing batch size -> 32.
Kai: routing 5% of EU traffic to canary cohort to limit blast radius.
Doug: telemetry alert thresholds set: error_rate > 1% OR p95 > baseline +200ms => auto-pause.
DeployBot: flag `llm-route-v2` set to 10% (cohorts: us-east:10, eu-west:5) — 23:06 UTC.
Mira: if stable, move to 30% in 10m. Holding window start.
Anya: seeing modest token delta on billing — expected during warmups.
Sasha: spike at 23:12 tied to a long-running session; marking session for slowpath rollback.
Doug: propose hold at 30% and pin affected sessions to v3.0 if error spike >1.2% — ready to execute.
Mira: agreed. Hold and observe for 15m.
Ops-Oncall: initiated graceful drain of one canary node (drain id `d-77`) to reduce cache churn.
DeployBot: canary upgrade complete; no deploy errors.
Mira: ramping to 50% at 23:20 via incremental 25% slices.
DeployBot: ramp paused at 40% due to p95 breach (signal from telemetry). Auto-pause triggered.
Mira: pausing ramp. Rolling back to 20% and pinning traffic to v3.0 for cohorts showing elevated p95.
Anya: opening follow-up postmortem thread — will attach prompt sets and eval diffs.
Doug: note for release notes: "Incremental feature-flag ramp with safety holds; automatic fallback to v3.0 triggered for select cohorts." Include link to telemetry graphs.
Sasha: added runbook link: <https://redwood/release/runbooks/ff-ramp>
DeployBot: action executed — flag set to 20%, eu-west cohort pinned to v3.0, drain id `d-77` in progress.
Ops-Oncall: marking synthetic alert as noisy; we rely on real-traffic signal for this roll.
Mira: thanks — setting 1-hour quiet window before any further ramps. Will document in release notes and update the ticket.
Kai: scheduling a morning soak to re-evaluate heatmaps and token costs.
DeployBot: if no further signals, will resume incremental ramp tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Mira: leaving this thread open for notes; will re-open if rollback/incident required. :thumbsup:
End.
